edits.value_json: 名 means “name” or “to name.” Its visible form has 夕 above 口. A traditional explanation connects evening with speaking a name when people cannot see one another, but this account of the graph’s original motivation is unverified.
The current form has 夕 above 口. In the traditional explanation, 夕 supplies the evening setting; that role as part of 名’s original construction is unverified.
The current form has 口 below 夕. In the traditional explanation, 口 contributes speaking a name; that account of the graph’s original construction is unverified.
